meta.name: dev-browser
meta.description: Browser automation with persistent page state. Use when users ask to navigate websites, fill forms, take screenshots, extract web data, test web apps, or automate browser workflows. Trigger phrases include "go to [url]", "click on", "fill out the form", "take a screenshot", "scrape", "automate", "test the website", "log into", or any browser interaction request.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动操作浏览器,完成打开网页、填表、截图与取数等重复流程
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常要在网页上重复点按、填表、登录或抓取数据
copy.tagline_en: Drive a browser automatically to open pages, fill forms, take screenshots and pull data
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you repeat clicks, forms or data pulls on websites

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会替你操作浏览器:打开网址、点击元素、填表、截图、抓取页面数据,并用小脚本一步步完成,页面状态在多次脚本运行之间保留。
howto.when: 当你让 Claude 操作网页(如打开网址、填表、截图等)时接管。有两种模式:独立启动一个新 Chromium,或通过扩展连接你已登录的 Chrome。

say.text: 打开 example.com,截图看看页面上有什么
say.note: 会启动浏览器并保存截图

say.text: 用扩展连上我的 Chrome,打开我的邮箱页面
把 Hacker News 首页的标题和链接抓下来
say.note: 用脚本抓取并返回数据

howto.what_en: Claude drives a browser for you: it opens URLs, clicks, fills forms, screenshots and scrapes pages with small scripts, and page state persists across script runs.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask Claude to act on a web page, e.g. open a URL, fill a form, screenshot. Two modes: a fresh Chromium, or your logged-in Chrome via extension.

say_en.text: Open example.com and take a screenshot
say_en.note: Launches the browser and saves a screenshot

say_en.text: Connect to my Chrome via extension and open my inbox
say_en.note: Requires the extension installed and active

say_en.text: Scrape the titles and links from Hacker News
say_en.note: Runs a script and returns the data
